mechanics.title: Expanded enchantment targets
mechanics.description: Axes, tridents, maces, bows, crossbows, shields and other gear can take enchantments normally limited to other items. Bows can get Multishot, Piercing, Quick Charge and Looting; crossbows can get Power, Punch, Infinity, Flame and Looting; tridents and maces can get Looting, Knockback, Sharpness, Smite, Bane of Arthropods, Impaling, Breach and more; horse, wolf and nautilus armor can take armor enchantments such as Protection, Feather Falling, Frost Walker, Soul Speed and Thorns.

mechanics.title: Relaxed exclusivity
mechanics.description: Infinity + Mending and Multishot + Piercing are compatible by default. Optional stacking of Sharpness with Smite/Bane/Impaling/Breach and of Protection with Fire/Blast/Projectile Protection exists; whether it is enabled is controlled by bundled datapacks and was not verified.

mechanics.title: Improved vanilla enchantments
mechanics.description: Infinity no longer requires a spare arrow, Looting and Fortune give extra experience, Feather Falling prevents farmland trampling, and Multishot benefits from removed projectile invulnerability.

vanilla_changes.what: Channeling, Frost Walker and Power enchantments
vanilla_changes.change: The mod overrides the minecraft:channeling, frost_walker and power enchantment definitions (Power shown as +0.5 damage base, +0.5 per level above first, max level 5). Exact differences from vanilla were not diffed.

editor_notes: Pack ships no override for this mod. Config is via datapacks (73 bundled files under universalenchants/datapacks). Overlaps with RemoveEnchantmentIncompatibility (both loosen exclusivity); check for conflicts. Requires Puzzles Lib.
name: Universal Enchants
summary: Lets many vanilla enchantments apply to more items and removes several compatibility restrictions, such as Looting on tridents, Infinity on crossbows and Sharpness on axes. It also improves a few enchantments (for example Infinity no longer needs a spare arrow).
